## Report

I implemented the frontend wiring but ran no build, typecheck, browser or test. I did view screenshots 01 and 02 (the 01 and 03 mobile menus). I did not open screenshot 3.

### Changed paths
- `src/pages/b3/[candidate]/[page].astro`: calls `loadRestaurantCatalogue` only for the collection and selection pages. Every other page keeps the original lab.
- `src/pages/b3/[candidate]/carta/[dish].astro`: builds the dish paths from `catalogue.module.offerings`, which gives 40 per profile and 160 in total. It keeps the existing `dishIds` guard.
- `src/components/composition/ExperienceComposition.astro`:
  - The lab type is now base plus an optional `catalogue`.
  - `menu` becomes `catalogue.module` when a catalogue exists.
  - `data-catalogue-sha256` is added next to the untouched content hash.
  - The grouped carta replaces `ContextualModule` on the collection and selection pages.
  - The page intro says "Cuarenta platos…".
  - The dish breadcrumb gains a group link.
  - The catalogue CSS is appended, and the client is emitted as `<script is:inline type="module" src>`, only on collection and selection.
- `src/components/composition/ArtisticPages.astro`: the same wiring for worlds 03 and 04.
- `src/components/composition/MenuCollection.astro`:
  - The old branch is kept verbatim under `catalogue ? … : old`.
  - New `catalogue` and `mode='browse'|'select'` props.
  - It renders one h3 per category, with `section#cat-<id>` anchors, a native category nav, and h4 dish names.
  - Select mode has a `data-demo-add` button hidden until JS shows it, a "Ver mi selección" link to `#seleccion`, and a toast.
  - The tools stay hidden without JS.
- `src/components/composition/DishDetail.astro`:
  - `hasMedia = !!presentation.offering_media[id]` guards both the media loading and the photo and video markup.
  - Related dishes are capped at 3, same category first.
  - "Volver a {grupo}" links to `#cat-<group>`.
  - Text-only dishes get an `is-text` class.
  - The disclosure line comes from the catalogue.
- New `src/design/catalogue-client.js`: plain JS, no TypeScript.
- New `src/design/catalogue.css`: scoped to `.cat-menu` and `.dish-page.is-text`, with four skins.

### Decisions
- **No legacy hooks:** the grouped menu uses `data-cat-*` hooks and `.cat-*` classes. It avoids `.menu-carta`, `.contextual-collection` and the `[data-menu-*]` hooks, so the legacy filter, the refinement client and `menu-carta.css` never touch it. `menu-carta.css` is not appended when a catalogue exists.
- **Search and filter:**
  - Search text is folded on the server and holds the name, category, description and ingredients.
  - The client folds the query the same way and requires every term to match.
  - The category filter works by group id, and the select has 8 options.
  - Groups with no matches are hidden. The count reads "N de 40 platos", and the category nav is never hidden.
  - Clicking a category anchor first resets any active filter, so the hash never points at a hidden group.
  - `?q=` and `?cat=` are also read.
- **Selection feedback:** a delegated click listener reads `[data-selection-count]` in a microtask after the legacy handler. It shows a fixed bottom toast and fills an sr-only live region. The toast hides while the selection panel is in view and after clearing. The selection state is not duplicated.
- **Query flow:** `?plato=` still works because each row keeps `data-offering-id` with the add button inside it. My client doesn't add anything itself.

### Uncertainties and risks for Codex to check
1. I didn't confirm the CSS tokens `--surface`, `--action`, `--on-action` and `--focus` exist in all four worlds. I used them as the existing CSS does.
2. `.order-layout` is a two-column grid on desktop with a sticky panel. Whether the 40-row list sits well beside it needs a screenshot.
3. The toast could overlap the footer or the last rows at the page bottom.
4. In text-only dishes, the 03 uppercase long names ("Ensalada mediterránea") need checking at all five widths.
5. The `?url` import of `catalogue-client.js` is always resolved, so the asset is emitted even though the script tag is conditional. Check that the old pages' HTML is byte-identical.
6. `exactOptionalPropertyTypes`: I spread `{...(catalogue?{catalogue}:{})}` where the prop is optional. `MenuCollection` receives `{catalogue}` directly only where it's defined. `lab.catalogue` on `ArtisticPages` is read from an `any` type.
7. No test or build has run. The facts-label map in `DishDetail` is unchanged. I haven't checked how it handles the description fact kind in the 36 new entries.
